A.track_cap: IF07 existing maximum per clip, 240 default; no model/window/bridge threshold changes
A.policy: T0 exact frozen IF08 charts and B2. T1 reconstruct the full candidate tracks from the identical complete coordinates and IF07 short pose edges; same-frame exact SIFT keypoint association, same overlap conflict rule. Per usable fixed chart reserve two coherent multi-view tracks with spatially separated reference points; choose least new global references, then effective observation span and static ID. Fill by original global longevity priority, with deterministic tie; count a track once across all windows. T2 unlimited only N03 diagnostic. B freezes T1 regardless of score.

B.policy: G0 historical B2/D evaluation only. G1 all evaluated T1 root pools, one direct attempt / disjoint independent fit and validation as IF08. G2 validate same frozen transform with extra frame-disjoint roots up to the same shared 8-per-group budget counting G1; never create source observations or votes by inverse transforms. Require valid projected support; conflicts retain both root sets. Single geometry disagreement is specific reprojection difference, not a distinct instance. White listed geometry, motion, raw gray, quality, photometry only; old timeline/appearance metadata not admitted.

C.policy: Controlled independent position, heading, displacement and reference-plane side inference. Real input uncalibrated: image-relative shared structure candidates, stable different surrounding visibility, independent abrupt candidate, cross-time re-observation. No semantic door or 3D pose/side assertion; optional boundary candidate ranges only, use uncropped no-cut controls and no legacy segmentation for new output.

P2.policy: Same 15 clips, 4 frozen Psmall proposals maximum actually available, 8 source images. S0 frozen exact; S1 residual components from temporal robust background within frozen proposal's sample budget; same .115 component contrast and .12 total support cap from IF07 Psmall, ROI only anchors initial track whereas searches use image coordinates. Require unique near continuous candidate under area, local shape and max displacement. S2 same S1 path; independently track surrounding reference features and fit partial affine with out-of-subject points, reject unsupported background or conflict. Measure raw appearance and signed relative displacement separately. Add a start/middle/end image only when stable visible reference-relative trajectory supports it; retain all frozen Psmall proposal and P1 broad roles within fixed budget. S3 and Qchain deferred.

scope: Old 15 plus N01-03, N04 deduplicated; no new safety clips or physical pose truth unless independently available. One run; no sweeps, labels not read by prediction, freeze source/code. No models, user research step not a real Agent run.
